marketing.feature3Body: Connect an injected browser wallet such as MetaMask, Rabby, or OKX. The trading demo uses Sepolia test assets.

bridge.headerKicker: Lock on the source chain, release on the destination. Every route below is read from the deployed gateway contracts.

dependencyPanel.title: Execution dependency status
dependencyPanel.note: Transfers unlock only when the API reports executable:true AND an on-chain bridge adapter plus a transfer-status projection exist. Neither exists in this repo yet, so this page stays quote-only by design.

bridge.headsUpBody: Quotes are sourced live from the bridge service. Execution is not offered because no bridge router contract exists in this deployment — nothing on this page signs or submits a transaction.

roadmap.title: Cross-chain bridge — not shipped yet
roadmap.kicker: This product ships only when transfers are real. No simulated bridge is presented as live.
roadmap.statusTitle: Why you can't bridge here today
roadmap.statusBody: A trustworthy bridge needs an audited on-chain adapter contract, a relayer that finalizes transfers on the destination chain, and a durable transfer-status record. None of those exist in this deployment yet, so the Bridge page is intentionally parked instead of showing quotes that cannot execute.
roadmap.honestyNote: Honesty contract: this route performs no route-quote calls and renders no transfer controls. It returns to the navigation only when a real, wallet-signable transfer path exists end to end.
roadmap.meanwhileBody: Swap and perpetuals are live against real Sepolia contracts — same wallet, real transactions.

trust.title: What you are trusting
trust.body: This is a trusted-relayer bridge, not a proof-based one. The destination gateway does not verify a source-chain proof — it trusts an operator-held relayer key.
trust.pointRelayer: A compromised relayer could drain destination liquidity.
trust.pointOffline: If the relayer goes offline your deposit is stranded until an admin refunds it.
trust.pointAdmin: The admin can withdraw escrowed funds.
trust.ack: I understand and want to continue

blockers.title: Why this route cannot execute
blockers.SAME_CHAIN: Source and destination are the same chain.
blockers.NO_SOURCE_GATEWAY: No gateway contract is deployed on the source chain.
blockers.NO_DESTINATION_GATEWAY: No gateway contract is deployed on the destination chain yet, so this route does not exist.
blockers.SOURCE_RPC_UNAVAILABLE: The source chain has a gateway but no RPC is configured, so its state cannot be read.
blockers.ROUTE_READ_FAILED: The gateway could not be read on-chain. This is a connectivity fault, not a missing route.
blockers.ROUTE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The gateway is deployed but this token route has not been opened.
blockers.GATEWAY_PAUSED: The gateway is paused by its admin and is not accepting new deposits.
blockers.BELOW_MIN_AMOUNT: Below the minimum transfer for this route ({min} {symbol}).
blockers.INSUFFICIENT_DESTINATION_LIQUIDITY: The destination gateway does not hold enough liquidity for this transfer ({available} available, {needed} needed).
blockers.DESTINATION_LIQUIDITY_UNKNOWN: Destination liquidity could not be read. Unknown — not zero.

nft.title: NFT Collection
nft.description: Browse and mint onchain artwork. Metadata and imagery are stored fully onchain or pinned to IPFS.

createToken.title: Launch a Token
createToken.description: Deploy an ERC-20 with a bonding curve from the browser. Configure supply, curve and metadata, then sign the deployment with your wallet.

nftStudio.title: NFT Studio
nftStudio.description: Mint onchain or IPFS-backed artwork NFTs. Preview the exact metadata and imagery before the mint transaction is signed.

token.title: Token Detail
token.description: Live price, market cap, 24h volume and onchain activity for tokens listed on Atlas X.
token.descriptionNamed: {name} ({symbol}) — live price, market cap, 24h volume and onchain trade activity on Atlas X.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Balances, open positions and portfolio value for your connected wallet.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Unified onchain activity feed for your connected wallet — trades, transfers, approvals and mints.

security.title: Security
security.description: Audit and revoke the token approvals your wallet has granted, and review connected sites.

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.description: Linked and watch-only wallets tracked in your Atlas X console.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Display, locale and network preferences for your Atlas X console.

profile.title: Wallet Profile
profile.description: Public activity and launched tokens for a wallet address.
